text_en: “Do not judge, so that you may not be judged.
text_cn: “你们不要判断人，免得你们受判断，

text_en: For with the judgment you make you will be judged, and the measure you give will be the measure you get.
text_cn: 因为你们用什么判断来判断，你们也要受什么判断；你们用什么尺度量给人，也要用什么尺度量给你们。

text_en: Why do you see the speck in your neighbor’s eye, but do not notice the log in your own eye?
text_cn: 为什么你只看见你兄弟眼中的木屑，而对自己眼中的大梁竟不理会呢？

text_en: Or how can you say to your neighbor, ‘Let me take the speck out of your eye, ’ while the log is in your own eye?
text_cn: 或者，你怎能对你的兄弟说：让我把你眼中的木屑取出来，而你眼中却有一根大梁呢？

text_en: You hypocrite, first take the log out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to take the speck out of your neighbor’s eye.
text_cn: 假善人哪！先从你眼中取出大梁，然后你才看得清楚，取出你兄弟眼中的木屑。

text_en: “Do not give what is holy to dogs; and do not throw your pearls before swine, or they will trample them under foot and turn and maul you.
text_cn: 你们不要把圣物给狗，也不要把你们的珠宝投在猪前，怕它们用脚践踏了珠宝，而又转过来咬伤你们。

text_en: “Ask, and it will be given you; search, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened for you.
text_cn: 你们求，必要给你们；你们找，必要找着；你们敲，必要给你们开，

text_en: For everyone who asks receives, and everyone who searches finds, and for everyone who knocks, the door will be opened.
text_cn: 因为凡是求的，就必得到；找的，就必找到；敲的，就必给他开。

text_en: Is there anyone among you who, if your child asks for bread, will give a stone?
text_cn: 或者，你们中间有哪个人，儿子向他求饼，反而给他石头呢？

text_en: Or if the child asks for a fish, will give a snake?
text_cn: 或者求鱼，反而给他蛇呢？

text_en: If you then, who are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask him!
text_cn: 你们纵然不善，尚且知道把好的东西给你们的儿女，何况你们在天之父，岂不更将好的赐与求他的人？

text_en: “In everything do to others as you would have them do to you; for this is the law and the prophets.
text_cn: 所以，凡你们愿意人给你们做的，你们也要照样给人做：法律和先知即在于此。”

text_en: “Enter through the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the road is easy that leads to destruction, and there are many who take it.
text_cn: “你们要从窄门进去，因为宽门和大路导入丧亡；但有许多的人从那里进去。

text_en: For the gate is narrow and the road is hard that leads to life, and there are few who find it.
text_cn: 那导入生命的门是多么窄，路是多么狭！找到它的人的确不多。

text_en: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing but inwardly are ravenous wolves.
text_cn: 你们要提防假先知！他们来到你们跟前，外披羊毛，内里却是凶残的豺狼。

text_en: You will know them by their fruits. Are grapes gathered from thorns, or figs from thistles?
text_cn: 你们可凭他们的果实辨别他们：荆棘上岂能收到葡萄？或者疾藜上岂能收到无花果？

text_en: In the same way, every good tree bears good fruit, but the bad tree bears bad fruit.
text_cn: 这样，凡是好树都结好果子，而坏树都结坏果子；

text_en: A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, nor can a bad tree bear good fruit.
text_cn: 好树不能结坏果子，坏树也不能结好果子。

text_en: Every tree that does not bear good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.
text_cn: 凡不结好果子的树，必要砍倒，投入火中。

text_en: Thus you will know them by their fruits.
text_cn: 所以，你们可凭他们的果实辨别他们。

text_en: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord, ’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of my Father in heaven.
text_cn: 不是凡向我说“主啊！主啊！”的人，就能进天国；而是那承行我在天之父旨意的人，才能进天国。

text_en: On that day many will say to me, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in your name, and cast out demons in your name, and do many deeds of power in your name? ’
text_cn: 到那一天有许多人要向我说：主啊！主啊！我们不是因你的名字说过预言，因你的名字驱过魔鬼，因你的名字行过许多奇迹吗？

text_en: Then I will declare to them, ‘I never knew you; go away from me, you evildoers. ’
text_cn: 那时，我必要向他们声明说：我从来不认识你们，你们这些作恶的人，离开我吧！”

text_en: “Everyone then who hears these words of mine and acts on them will be like a wise man who built his house on rock.
text_cn: “所以，凡听了我这些话而实行的，就好像一个聪明人，把自己的房屋建在磐石上：

text_en: The rain fell, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house, but it did not fall, because it had been founded on rock.
text_cn: 雨淋，水冲，风吹，袭击那座房屋，它并不坍塌，因为基础是建在磐石上。

text_en: And everyone who hears these words of mine and does not act on them will be like a foolish man who built his house on sand.
text_cn: 凡听了我这些话而不实行的，就好像一个愚昧人，把自己的房屋建在沙土上：

text_en: The rain fell, and the floods came, and the winds blew and beat against that house, and it fell—and great was its fall! ”
text_cn: 雨淋，水冲，风吹，袭击那座房屋，它就坍塌了，且坍塌的很惨。”

text_en: Now when Jesus had finished saying these things, the crowds were astounded at his teaching,
text_cn: 耶稣讲完了这些话，群众都惊奇他的教训，

text_en: for he taught them as one having authority, and not as their scribes.
text_cn: 因为他教训他们，正像有权威的人，不像他们的经师。
